name: Russia–Ukraine
value: 14 killed in a day; Kyiv bridges hit 17 Nov
summary: Russian strikes killed 14 across Ukraine in the day to 17 Nov, closing Kyiv's two main bridges and cutting power
state: Local authorities reported that Russian attacks killed 14 people and injured 78 across Ukraine in the day to 17 Nov; strikes damaged and closed Kyiv's Northern and Southern bridges and killed two in Obolonskyi district (Kyiv Independent; Ukrinform). Ukraine's energy ministry imposed emergency power cuts in four regions on 17 Nov, and about 700,000 households in Dnipropetrovsk lost power. Russia said it downed 1,441 Ukrainian drones overnight as Ukraine targeted the Kerch Bridge (AP). Sustained mass strikes keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice, which advises against all travel to Ukraine. Strikes on the grid mean power, heating and water cuts in Ukrainian cities as winter sets in.
rubric_hit: Mass-casualty strikes on energy sites and cities = Alert
